d: Thirsty for a following, a rideshare driver has figured out a deadly plan to go viral.
Teenagers discover a terrible secret when they break into the home of a mortician whose wife died two years earlier.
A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.
Venomous betrayals engulf a female married couple attempting to celebrate their one-year anniversary.
Friends (Brandy Schaefer, Mikey Roe, Jeff Larson) encounter genuine horror during a road trip to visit haunted houses.
Still recovering from their abduction last Halloween, friends head back out on the road in search of the ultimate spooky experience.
Three patients in an insane asylum experience hallucinations, altered realities and imaginary voices.
A detective tries to track down a masked killer who reappears every Halloween to wreak bloody havoc.
Emily, blind since a car accident killed her mother, has to protect herself and loved ones from an intruder.
Californian serial killer William Bonin (Scott Anthony Leet) searches for victims on the state's highways.

A typical night for veterans at a VFW turns into a battle for survival when a desperate teen runs into the bar. When a gang of punks come looking for her, the vets use every weapon at their disposal to protect themselves from an unrelenting attack.
A neurotic ventriloquist's belief that his stage dummy controls his actions leads him to murder, madness and more.
Psychics (Paul Le Mat, Irene Miracle, Matt Roe) at a bay hotel meet the puppets Pin Head, Leech Woman, Tunneler, Blade and Jester.

Hunter's (Brian Gallagher) life turns upside down after his daughter is killed by a drunken driver. He disappears into the woods, and no one sees him for years -- until several partying teenagers are brutally killed one by one.
A woman finds a VHS tape that shows a series of gruesome tales.

Vacationers think they've found the perfect place for a bachelor party, but a deadly, flesh-eating virus is waiting to infect them.
Astronauts (Christian Slater, Brendan Fehr) come under attack by dangerous alien spores after a meteor collides with their moon base.

Two couples rent a luxury home for the weekend, hoping to sort out their messed-up lives. Just as they are about to settle in for a fun night, a neighbor turns up at their door and claims she has car trouble. And that's when the terror really starts.
Locals in the California woods are attacked by supernatural creatures, and when the situation escalates into carnage, a farmer struggles to defend his family.

In the Old West, a sheriff (Kurt Russell), his deputy (Richard Jenkins), a gunslinger (Matthew Fox), and a cowboy (Patrick Wilson) embark on a mission to rescue three people from a savage group of cave dwellers.
Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.
A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.
A man sells a nefarious-looking puppet at a small-town convention for some quick cash. Terror soon strikes when an ancient evil animates the other puppets and sends them on a bloody killing spree.
A murderous assailant traps three people (Alice Eve, Josh Peck, Brian Geraghty) in a small kiosk containing an automatic teller machine.

Iris (Brittany Snow) and seven other desperate people become trapped in Shepard's (Jeffrey Combs) mansion. Shepard forces them to play a sadistic game for a large sum of money -- but the dilemmas become increasingly deadly.
As a serial killer stalks the city, a young actress who just moved to town with her boyfriend notices a mysterious stranger watching her from across the street.
